blocker_detail: Authoritative source endpoints were resolved, including ESCO's official web-service API. This execution environment still cannot materialize the required full payload bytes into the local runtime: the web layer can inspect pages/API documentation but does not expose arbitrary binary archives as local files, and the local container has no outbound DNS/network access. SHA-256 receipts and adapter dry-runs therefore cannot be truthfully produced in this run.

sources.publisher: European Commission DG Employment, Social Affairs and Inclusion
sources.note: Correction: ESCO is not categorically email-gated. The Commission provides a public web-service API for machine-to-machine access. The separate downloadable-package UI uses privacy acknowledgement/email delivery. Official current site metadata reports ESCO v1.2.1, while the public web-service API page presently documents selectable versions through v1.2.0; exact v1.2.1 API completeness must therefore be verified before treating API output as a full v1.2.1 acquisition.

next_transition: Use official direct files or official machine-to-machine APIs to materialize payload bytes in a network-capable runtime.
